title.zh: Meta发布Muse Wonder与Muse Wonder Full前沿AI模型
title.en: Meta releases Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full frontier AI models

current_state.zh: Meta已于2026年10月12日发布Muse Wonder与Muse Wonder Full，二者具备100万token上下文窗口，Muse Wonder已通过Meta Model API与Muse Code上线（Muse Wonder Full仅面向付费Muse Code订阅者），API定价为每百万输入/输出token 4美元/20美元；Meta自评基准领先GPT-6 Astra与Claude Opus 5.5，但第三方Artificial Analysis仍将Opus 5.5列为第一。
current_state.en: Meta released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full on 2026-10-12 with a 1 million token context window; Muse Wonder is live via the Meta Model API and Muse Code (Muse Wonder Full reserved for paying Muse Code subscribers) at $4/$20 per million input/output tokens. Meta's own benchmarks put them ahead of GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5, though third-party Artificial Analysis still ranks Opus 5.5 first.

updates.title_zh: Meta 推出了几款 Wonder Full 新 AI 模型
updates.title_en: Meta has some Wonder Full new AI models
updates.what_changed_zh: Meta 从其超级智能实验室推出了两款新 AI 模型 Muse Wonder 和 Muse Wonder Full，声称它们能与业界领先的模型竞争。
updates.what_changed_en: Meta launched two new AI models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, from its Superintelligence Labs, claiming they can compete with the industry's leading models.

updates.title_zh: Meta 的新 Muse Wonder 终于让扎克伯格跻身前沿 AI 竞赛
updates.title_en: Meta's New Muse Wonder Finally Puts Zuckerberg in the Frontier AI Race
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道补充了Muse Wonder与Muse Wonder Full发布的具体细节：100万token上下文窗口、API版Muse Wonder定价为每百万输入/输出token 4美元/20美元、通过Meta Model API与Muse Code上线（Full仅供付费Muse Code订阅者），并给出Meta自评基准（Personal Superintelligence Index 59.1、SWE-Marathon 57.5、Harvey Legal Agent 13.1）及Artificial Analysis排名仍将Opus 5.5列第一。
updates.what_changed_en: New reporting adds specifics of the Muse Wonder / Muse Wonder Full launch: 1 million token context window, API version Muse Wonder priced at $4/$20 per million input/output tokens, availability now via Meta Model API and Muse Code (Full reserved for paying Muse Code subscribers), Meta's own benchmark scores (Personal Superintelligence Index 59.1, SWE-Marathon 57.5, Harvey Legal Agent 13.1), and Artificial Analysis still ranking Opus 5.5 first.

Meta's own benchmarks put them ahead of GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5, though third-party Artificial Analysis still ranks Opus 5.5 first.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Meta released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, the first frontier-class models from Meta Superintelligence Labs, featuring a 1 million token context window and pricing at $4/$20 per million input/output tokens, with Meta's own benchmarks placing them above GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 while Artificial Analysis still ranks Opus 5.5 first.
